title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 65 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 65)

content.overview: Section 65 — Submission of statements to conciliator belongs to the former conciliation regime in Part III of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The detailed conciliation provisions were superseded by the Mediation Act, 2023. This file is retained for historical/transition reference and must not be presented as the current general conciliation procedure.

content.study:
Historical section 65 — Submission of statements to conciliator

Section 65 — Submission of statements to conciliator belongs to the former conciliation regime in Part III of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The detailed conciliation provisions were superseded by the Mediation Act, 2023. This file is retained for historical/transition reference and must not be presented as the current general conciliation procedure.

Current-law rule: use the Mediation Act, 2023 for current mediation. Section 62 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act preserves conciliation proceedings initiated under the former sections 61 to 81 before commencement of the Mediation Act, 2023, subject to its saving terms.
